faces.name: Pressure Point
faces.oracleText:
Tap target creature.
Draw a card.

faces.name: Preston Garvey, Minuteman
faces.oracleText:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, create a green Aura enchantment token named Settlement attached to up to one target land you control. It has enchant land and "Enchanted land has '{T}: Add one mana of any color.'"
Whenever Preston Garvey attacks, untap each enchanted permanent you control.

faces.name: Preston's Stage
faces.oracleText:
Whenever a player performs a magic trick, they create a Hat token. (You perform a magic trick when you cast an instant or spell with flash, or turn a face-down creature face-up. Hat tokens are artifact tokens with "{1}, {T}, Sacrifice this artifact: Create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token.")
Whenever Chaos ensues, until your next turn, creature cards in your hand have flash.

faces.name: Preston, the Vanisher
faces.oracleText:
Whenever another nontoken creature you control enters, if it wasn't cast, create a token that's a copy of that creature, except it's a 0/1 white Illusion.
{1}{W}, Sacrifice five Illusions: Exile target nonland permanent.

faces.name: Presumed Dead
faces.oracleText: Until end of turn, target creature gets +2/+0 and gains "When this creature dies, return it to the battlefield under its owner's control and suspect it." (A suspected creature has menace and can't block.)
